propositions: Documentation incorrectly claims bug tickets are gate-exempt with runner=exempt, but the actual code reviews bugs under the bug review tier with runner=pydantic_ai and coverage.llm_ran=True
workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck only short-circuits session_log, code_review, and identity types to exempt status; bugs receive light advisory review and can be coached but never blocked
The docs conflate two separate exemption axes: CLI-side claim-time exemption for bugs versus gate-side review exemption, which only applies to session_log/code_review/identity
Stale documentation statements must be corrected to reflect that bugs are reviewed under the bug tier, not exempt from the gate
Existing test test_bug_review_tier.py already validates that bugs are not exempt and have runner != exempt
